event_records.description: Bill and the Osei family are aware of the fence damage and have had initial discussions about cost sharing, but no agreement has been reached.

bill.name: Bill
bill.persona_brief:
You are Bill.
Bill believes the fence is shared property and the Osei family should pay half the repair cost. He is willing to negotiate but will consider small claims if no agreement is reached.

osei_family.name: Osei family
osei_family.persona_brief:
You are Osei family.
The Osei family believes the fence is Bill's responsibility or that they should pay less than half. They prefer to avoid court but are firm on their position.

resolution.question: Neighbors Bill and the Osei family disagree over who pays for a storm-damaged shared fence. Will they agree on a cost split, without going to small claims, within two months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that Bill and the Osei family have both agreed to a specific cost split (e.g., 50-50 or another proportion) and have communicated that agreement to each other. Resolve NO if no such agreement is recorded by the cutoff.
